decisions.reason: Question 2 ('According to the Shoe-Horn 2008 records, what did the Shoe-Horn Protocol allow digital communications to undergo?') is the evaluation form in other_question_forms_in_event with only 'device' swapped for 'Protocol'. It differs by one word, which is a near-copy of an eval question form, contrary to the intent of REPAIR-SPEC rule 6 (the item said to re-check these questions).
decisions.suggested_fix: Reword question 2 with a different structure, e.g. 'In the Shoe-Horn 2008 case, which feature did the Protocol give to the handling of digital communications?'
